svg.text: Seen from above. Forward is up.
Blue arrow: the push on the vehicle for positive thrust (horizontal thrusters, at 45 degrees).
Crossed circle: heave thruster, pointing up and down. Positive thrust pushes the vehicle down.
Order in ThrusterForces and the PWM array: 1 back_right, 2 heave_back_right, 3 heave_front_right,
In the ThrusterForces message only, front_right is negated (thrust_mapper.py).
